title: Publish manifest
description: manifest/{publish_id}.json, uploaded last by a publish (WP3) and named by the Worker's MANIFEST_KEY (WP4, switched by WP8's deploy only after the upload finished). The Worker reads it once per isolate (cached a minute) and builds every key from its family tags; it answers /version.json and /frames/slices.json from it. Version strings live here and only here, written from frame_server.picture_versions() at publish time.

publish_id.description: UTC time of the publish and the commit it was made from

versions.description: frame_server.picture_versions() as the cache was built

families.description: {family: tag} for every family in keys.json, keys.family_tags(versions)

slices.description: the /frames/slices.json answer for what was published (slices.covered's shape: {spans: [[from, until], ...] or null, phases: {...}})

version.description: the /version.json answer (frame_server.site_version's shape) for the site and pictures published

counts.description: published.json's summary: objects and bytes per family and year
